title: Coherence Transfer in Quantum Networks
summary: Detecting coherence transfer in complex quantum networks can be challenging due to uncharacterized experimental conditions and limited system access. Here, we use static and dynamic coherence features to introduce a nonlinear criterion for identifying coherence transfer. The criterion requires only two measurement settings for network-state populations in an experimental state basis, regardless of the network's size.
